Rijk Zwaan, Syngenta and Enza Zaden are leading this market.
Bemol (RZ) is the leadaer variety in RBP Spring.
Most of the companies are transforming their portfolio to PM resistant.
The crop cycle ha been reduced in the last 5 years, finishing the crops in september and nowadays in July. Earlyness is a key trait to be present in the early plantations.
Good behaviour to botrytis is also very important, specially in raining years.
